value.title: Decided routing semantics in docs/api/routing.md with no remaining marker (wave 4)

acceptanceCriteria.text: `docs/api/routing.md` describes the `//`, trailing-slash and case policy switches and their strict default, the `TRACE`/`CONNECT` enable policy, the `Allow` set rule, the lookup result order including WebSocket-only for plain `GET`/`HEAD` and the upgrade fallback, per-method priority with the `DELETE /users/me` example, the pattern validation errors (empty or repeated variable name, empty segment), policy-normalised conflict detection, case-sensitive method tokens, the upgrade-flag header rule, the path rejection rules applied before lookup and single percent-decoding of parameters (`%252e` gives `%2e`). [D-070; re_stated_from: OPS-ROUTE-001#AC1; the clause 'without naming configuration API methods' is dropped because wave 3 names `app.routerPolicy(RouterPolicy)` under D-398]

`docs/api/routing.md` names the `MethodSet` membership and iteration accessors exactly as implemented, with a Java and a Kotlin example each and its Express counterpart or a note that Express has none. [D-038; re_stated_from: OPS-ROUTE-001#AC2]

From wave 4 no line of `docs/api/routing.md` contains `(미확정)`: the `RouteBuilder.use(middleware)` marker is replaced by the wave 4 decision of OPS-APP-001 AC-2, and the markers on the `TRACE`/`CONNECT` setting API, on the `//`/trailing-slash/case setting API and on the `req.method()` value during automatic `HEAD` stay gone; `RoutingDocsTest` is re-pointed to this requirement. [D-109; D-398; D-137]
